prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached then take it, do specific task, move to destination, and scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsDestinationReached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectGrabbed    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
		DO MoveToDestination
	END
